# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Please use the table below to check if the version of the project you are using is currently supported with security updates.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| any     | [x]       |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of this project seriously. If you believe you have found a security vulnerability, please do **NOT** open a public issue or pull request. Instead, report it responsibly via the channels below.

### Reporting Channels

- **Email:** Please email your report to [stordalamundgard@gmail.com](mailto:stordalamundgard@gmail.com).

### What to Include

Please include the following details in your report to help us understand and resolve the issue quickly:

1. **Description:** A detailed description of the vulnerability and its potential impact.
2. **Steps to Reproduce:** Clear, step-by-step instructions (or a proof-of-concept script/exploit) to reproduce the behavior.
3. **Environment:** The exact version of the software, operating system, and any relevant configuration details.

### Our Process

- **Acknowledgment:** You will receive an acknowledgment of your report within **48 hours**.
- **Updates:** We will keep you informed of our progress as we investigate and work on a fix.
- **Disclosure:** We follow a responsible disclosure policy. We ask that you do not publicly disclose the vulnerability until a fix has been released and coordinated.
